name: Sludgehammer
body:
School conjuration [acid, earth]; Level druid 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a clump of clay and a drop of acid)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area cylinder (10-ft. radius, 40-ft. high)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a mass of caustic sludge that you bring violently down in the area. The spell deals 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 15d6). Half the damage is acid damage and half bludgeoning an affected creature is slowed as per the spell slow for 1d4 rounds afterward. A successful Reflex save halves the damage and negates the slowing effect.
